messages:
allhands-bot: Post-all-hands pulse: drop quick strategy follow-ups here (short answers live, deeper threads later).
jamie_ceo: Quick note: answering high-level ones here, we'll publish a concise FAQ after edits.
sam_product: Can we get one crisp mission line that product + sales can rally around?
jamie_ceo: Draft: "Make inference for LLMs predictable, affordable, and operable across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments." Thoughts?
lee_growth: Love it. For non-technical leads, can we swap "inference" for "LLM features"?
maya_sales: Customers keep asking: how are we different from hyperscalers who bundle models + infra?
jamie_ceo: Short: hyperscalers focus on model access; we focus on serving economics and predictable SLAs across environments.
arun_research: Competitor play: "our proprietary models are better"  do we call that out publicly?
jamie_ceo: No direct attacks. Show facts: transparent perf profiles, migration stories, and the economics of serving.
olivia_cto: Tech callouts to emphasize in decks: unified API, automatic KV caching, smart routing, verified perf profiles. Those are operational differentiators.
dana_sre: For SRE folks in customers: what guarantees do we advertise for Dedicated? p95/p99?
jamie_ceo: Baseline p95/p99 by model class and instance type; per-route SLAs for enterprise tiers. Docs to include examples.
sam_product: Actionables: who owns the public FAQ, benchmark kit, and sales one-pager?
jamie_ceo: Sam + Olivia own the FAQ and benchmark kit (Olivia technical), Maya + Lee own the one-pager + migration slide. I'll review.
maya_sales: Also request: a short migration incentive plan (credits/discounts) we can share with prospects.
jamie_ceo: Simple: migration credits year1 + tiered commit discounts. Finance will define thresholds.
lee_growth: I'll draft three audience-specific value props (devs, infra, legal) and post them here.
arun_research: I'll prepare a model provenance checklist for compliance customers.
olivia_cto: Will publish a small reproducible perf kit (OSS-friendly) that shows latency + cost for common seq lengths.
jamie_ceo: Great. Owners post drafts in this thread by EOD Wed. If it gets long, spin up focused threads. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
